fact: 2010-07-18（周日）凌晨三点：Henry 43 岁、Clare 39、Beck 34、Alba 8。全章是 Clare 第一人称：她被电话铃惊醒、心慌意乱，先想到「Henry？Alba？」，身边睡着一个人，她以为是 Henry，随即想起——是 Beck。
quote: Sunday, July 18, 2010 (Henry is 43, Clare is 39, Beck is 34, Alba is 8) ... Clare: I wake up panicked and confused. The phone is ringing. I think, Henry? Alba? There’s someone sleeping next to me and I think it’s Henry and then I remember, Beck.

fact: 她把听筒从座架上碰落到床上、按下止响键；Beck 在睡梦中翻身叹气。她低声「Hello?」，对面是「Clare?」——是 Henry，她立刻清醒。她披上浴袍、把电话夹在肩上，尽量不出声地走出卧室带上门；Beck 看似仍睡着。Alba 在外公（Richard）家。
quote: I fumble the phone off its cradle and onto the bed and manage to press the button that quells the jarring noise. Beck turns toward me in her sleep and sighs. ... Henry. Now I’m awake. ... Alba is with her grandfather.

fact: Henry 说他在 Newberry 图书馆、在自己的办公室——「Though it seems to be someone else’s office now」，并问今天几号；Clare 答「2010. July, maybe the 18th?」她一路走进厨房关上门；白天很热、睡时空调开得很猛，此刻厨房地板冰凉。
quote: “I’m at the Newberry, in my office,” Henry says. “Though it seems to be someone else’s office now. What’s the date?” “2010. July, maybe the 18th?” ... Now the kitchen floor is cold under my bare feet.
anchor: “I’m at the Newberry, in my office,”

fact: 她问要不要去接他，他说不行——凌晨三点、警报开着，进不去，「Just talk to me」。他的来处是 2006 年 11 月 2 日周四；她问「Are you—okay?」，他答不太好，坐在地上，椅子稳不住，来之前刚吃过止痛药；他的双脚一个月前（在他的当下）才失去，断口还新、还疼。他要她讲讲她和 Alba 的事来分他的心。
quote: “2006. Thursday, November 2.” ... “I’m sitting on the floor; I can’t even figure out how to get this chair to hold still while I try to get into it. I took some pain meds right before I ended up here” ... his stumps new and painful; he only lost his feet a month ago, in his present.

fact: 她在心里盘算哪些能说、哪些不能说，然后报喜：Alba 拉小提琴进步很大；「Your dad has been considerably less shouty lately.」Henry 心疼女儿，怀疑当初该不该让父亲教她、该不该换个「没那么天才但更温和」的老师。
quote: I inventory the things I can and cannot tell him. “Alba’s making a lot of progress with the violin. Your dad has been considerably less shouty lately.” ... “Maybe we should have sent her to someone less brilliant but more gentle?”
anchor: I inventory the things I can and cannot tell him

fact: Clare 说除 Richard 之外还有一位极好的老师、能缓冲父亲的吼叫，但叮嘱「You can't mention this to your dad」——因为「Older Albas」说过：Richard 把 Alba 教成了很好的演奏者，却也让她不想再拉琴，「So, not a perfect success.」Henry 说「No. I want her to love music.」
quote: “And we do have someone, in addition to Richard, who’s a terrific teacher, so that’s buffering the shoutiness. You can’t mention this to your dad, though. Older Albas have said that Richard made her a very good player but also made her not want to play. So, not a perfect success.”
anchor: “You can’t mention this to your dad, though.”

fact: Alba 给 Henry 拉过她自己写的曲子：一首独奏小提琴赋格，听上去惊人，看着「strenuous」（费力）；她说那是她二十几岁写的，那时她长期独处、好几周没人跟她说话才理清；Henry 说女儿听见的想法他自己连表述都做不到。Clare 说「It's funny when our kid gets way beyond us.」，Henry 接「And then she's a kindergartener again the next time I see her.」
quote: “Yeah. It was a fugue for solo violin. It sounded amazing and looked sort of—strenuous. ... She said she was spending a lot of time alone and was able to work it all out without anyone talking to her for weeks.” ... “And then she’s a kindergartener again the next time I see her.”
anchor: “It was a fugue for solo violin.”

fact: Henry 讲他那一天：四个人在床上过了一整天——Kimy 过来，Alba 因为「我最近不像个爸爸」而难过，于是大家将就着把床当营地，玩棋盘游戏、在床上吃零食；规矩是谁都不许碰地板，除了上厕所和拿吃的；Kimy 和 Alba 午后睡了一觉；Clare 则在素描本上画他们。Clare 记得那天，也记得当夜独自醒来、不知 Henry 去了哪里，久到他不见踪影她才又睡着，早晨却发现他在身边——如今这份担心换来了这通电话。
quote: “We spent the day in bed. Kimy came over, and Alba was feeling upset because I haven’t been much of a dad lately. So we made a virtue of necessity and all four of us spent the day playing board games and eating snacks on our bed. The rule was, no one could touch the floor except to go to the bathroom or to get food.” ... You were drawing us in your sketchbook.

fact: Henry 说「I hate being a burden. I'm sorry.」；Clare 说「I would give almost anything to have you back again.」两人沉默，他唤「Oh, Clare.」她盯着渐渐变浓的茶稳住声音说「I don't regret anything.」，Henry 说「I do」——他宁愿在家陪她，而不是随机地被抛到别的年代；「Time travel feels like a terrible job now, doing something useless and waiting to clock out.」她刚说「But if not for time travel—」，他就接「We wouldn't have met. I know.」「I'm sure it all balances, somehow.」
quote: Henry says, “I hate being a burden. I’m sorry.” I say, “I would give almost anything to have you back again.” ... “I do,” Henry replies. “I wish I’d been able to be at home with you, not out there in other time, randomly. Time travel feels like a terrible job now, doing something useless and waiting to clock out.”
anchor: “I hate being a burden. I’m sorry.”

fact: 关于 Alba 怎么找到他：Henry 说是「Need, I think. We need each other, so we find each other.」——他们正把一辈子的父女相处挤进他生命最后这几年，「It's more spread out, for her, thank goodness.」Clare 说 Alba 未必每次都告诉她见了他，「It's like she's embarrassed to have time with you if I don't」，并提到教她「分享」时她太当真，自己吃饼干而 Nadia 和 Rosa 没有就会哭。
quote: “Need, I think,” Henry says. “We need each other, so we find each other. We’re cramming a lifetime of father-daughter togetherness into these last couple of years of my life.” ... “It’s like she’s embarrassed to have time with you if I don’t.”

fact: Henry 问 Alba 多大了，「Eight?」，Clare 说「Yeah. Nine, in a couple of months.」他想让她接电话、跟女儿说句话；Clare 装作随意地说「Alba is staying over at Richard's tonight.」Henry 诧异：「I thought you only left her with Dad when you go up to South Haven?」她编说是明天一早有实地考察、Richard 要带她去城里找制琴师修琴桥——「This errand actually took place yesterday, but I don't want to mention Beck.」
quote: “I don’t suppose you could wake her up? Just to say hello?” I try to sound casual. “Alba is staying over at Richard’s tonight.” ... “She’s just having a new bridge fitted.” This errand actually took place yesterday, but I don’t want to mention Beck.
anchor: “I don’t suppose you could wake her up?”

fact: 她忽然担心 Beck 是否在听她这半通电话——「Two doors and a short hallway suddenly seem like not enough」；她端着茶走进 Alba 的房间坐在床上，把 Blue Teddy 从枕头与墙的缝里抽出来，放回床尾「Most Favored Toys」阵列的正中，并对 Henry 说「Richard hasn't called in a panic. That's a first.」
quote: I wonder if Beck is listening to my half of this conversation. Two doors and a short hallway suddenly seem like not enough. ... Blue Teddy is wedged between her pillow and the wall; I extract him and put him in his rightful place at the center of an assembly of Most Favored Toys at the foot of Alba’s bed.
anchor: I wonder if Beck is listening

fact: 「你见过老去的 Alba 吗？」Henry 说没有，反问她；她说见过，「I've seen her in her sixties.」——知道 Alba 能活到那把年纪让她安心，是她每次女儿消失几天都不至于崩溃的原因。随后她说「You've seen me old.」，Henry 一惊「How did you know?」，她说「You wrote me a letter. Or, you will write a letter.」——「It's one of my most treasured possessions. No pressure.」
quote: “Yes,” I assure him. “I’ve seen her in her sixties.” It’s ease of mind, to know that Alba will make it that far. ... “You wrote me a letter. Or, you will write a letter.” ... “It’s one of my most treasured possessions. No pressure.”

fact: Henry 笑起来，那声音把她带回从前共度的生活，她一时极为快乐，同时又预感到几分钟后电话挂断、Henry 再度消失时的空洞。他问「Clare? Are you there?」，她说「Yes, I'm here.」；他听出她声音发抖，她答「Yeah. I mean, no. You know.」他说「Listen, I meant to—」，随后是一声闷响（像是听筒落到地毯上）——他走了。她对空房间说「I'm listening」，「I love you, is what I wanted to hear, to say.」
quote: “Yeah,” he replies. “Listen, I meant to—” There’s a muffled sound, perhaps the receiver hitting the carpet? “I’m listening,” I say to the empty room where Henry was, just a moment ago. But he’s gone. I love you, is what I wanted to hear, to say.

fact: 她挂了电话回到厨房，发现 Beck 坐在桌边、闭着眼、头枕在交叠的手臂上；她刚才太沉在过去，几乎忘了现在，幸而 Beck 没看见。Beck 睁开一只眼又睁开另一只，问「Was that him?」她答「Yes.」
quote: I walk back to the kitchen, where I find Beck sitting at the table, eyes closed, her head cradled on her folded arms. I was so lost in the past, just now, that the present flew out of my mind completely. ... “Was that him?”

fact: 没化妆的 Beck 显得更软、比白天年轻：白睡衣、和服袖的绿松石色浴袍、樱花纹丝巾包着头发，「She looks like a sleepy empress.」她在担心却不想露出来；天还黑，她开了窗，暖风吹进来，带着绣球花和没收走的垃圾的气味。
quote: Without her makeup, Beck looks softer, younger than her daytime self. She’s wearing white pajamas, a turquoise blue bathrobe with kimono sleeves and a silk scarf with a cherry blossom pattern wrapping her hair. She looks like a sleepy empress. ... scented with hydrangeas and uncollected garbage.
anchor: Without her makeup, Beck looks softer

fact: Clare 说 Henry 剩下的时间不多了、这样的电话不会再有几通，「I hope you can understand. It's just a little bit of my life that I'm living out of order.」Beck 问：会不会有另一条时间线，Henry 没死，而我们从未相遇、或只是朋友？Clare 答「If that time exists, we don't know or care what we missed. But here and now, I love you.」——这并不表示她爱 Henry 少一些；她最想他，正是在他这样从未来出现半小时的时候，因为对他而言那份悲伤就在眼前。
quote: “He doesn’t have very much time left. There won’t be many more of these calls. I hope you can understand. It’s just a little bit of my life that I’m living out of order.” ... “If that time exists, we don’t know or care what we missed. But here and now, I love you.”
anchor: “He doesn’t have very much time left.”

fact: Beck 说「It seems wrong to think of Henry as dead when you were just talking to him.」，Clare 承认自己会错觉他只是「away」，然后想起来、就疼。Beck 说起 Jasper：他没死，可她一直在哀悼他；久不想他时他就打电话来——「But it does seem less world ending since I met you.」她伸手、掌心向上，Clare 把手覆上去，两人坐着听鸟醒来。
quote: “It seems wrong to think of Henry as dead when you were just talking to him,” Beck says. “I know. I catch myself thinking that he’s just—away. Then I remember, and that hurts.” ... “But it does seem less world ending since I met you.” Beck offers her hand, palm up.
anchor: “It seems wrong to think of Henry as dead”

fact: 回床上并肩躺着、手扣着手：Beck 问「You said you love me?」，Clare 说「Yes. I love you.」，Beck 说「I love you, too.」——这是两人第一次互相说这句话；她们接吻、睡去。早晨 Henry 显得遥远、不真实；她在厨房看见水槽里的杯子、桌边并拢的两把椅子，回到心里的是「I'm sure it all balances, somehow」和「I love you, too.」
quote: “You said you love me?” Beck asks. “Yes,” I say. “I love you.” “I love you, too,” Beck says. It’s the first time we’ve said it to each other. We kiss, and then we sleep. ... what comes back to me is I’m sure it all balances, somehow, and I love you, too.
